Built a stylized octopus chef at a Japanese ramen booth (yatai) entirely in Blender and verified it through rendered views.

The scene features a coral-pink octopus wearing a puffy white chef's hat and red scarf, with eight curved tentacles — holding chopsticks over a bowl, gripping a ladle, resting on the counter, and reaching toward a stock pot. It stands behind a wooden counter with three blue ramen bowls (broth, noodles, narutomaki, egg, and green onions, plus translucent steam wisps), cooking pots and prep bowls on a back counter, and menu boards. The booth has a teal slanted roof with a red-trimmed fascia and sign board with a red emblem, navy noren curtains at the sides, glowing cream and pink paper lanterns, side lantern posts, and four red stools in front.

Files in `./output/` (4 total):

- [octopus-ramen-booth.glb](output/octopus-ramen-booth.glb) — 2.3 MB glTF binary, no Draco/meshopt compression, validated as glTF 2.0 with 211 meshes and 26 materials
- [hero.png](output/hero.png) — three-quarter hero view (1200×900, 1.3 MB)
- [front.png](output/front.png) — straight-on view showing the chef's face, hat, and tentacles (1.3 MB)
- [side.png](output/side.png) — opposite three-quarter view (1.4 MB)

All renders were checked visually across multiple iterations — fixing the roof and sign board that initially hid the chef, correcting inverted bowl geometry, and clearing the center lantern and noren curtains so the octopus reads clearly from every published angle.
